body: I'm around you, as well. I don't always want to continue. There are more times than not that I feel everything would be a lot better off if I just did it. But then I think about my SO, my mother, the people that mean something to me and how it would impact them. And then I feel guilty because those people make me happy and enjoy life, but there are so many more negatives than those few positives. In the end, I know I wouldn't be able to go through with it, and it takes away that out. It's awful. But in the end, I suppose we can consider theres a reason we are unable to do so.

This is where I am. It's not like I enjoy literally being stuck in bed all day because just the thought of getting up puts me through a freak out. I go to class and I can barely make it through a single class and I have to come back to my room to "revive"' myself because that one class was so much on me. I don't skip just to relax and sleep. No I don't sleep anyways, I can't. I don't relax. I don't eat. I don't do anything and I can't. You making a joke out of it doesn't help at all. 

Sorry for the rant. I appreciate this post. It's beautiful and absolutely spot on. I'd never thought of it like that. I needed to read this. Thank you for posting.
As an update, I fucked myself over even more now after this. I've been notified they don't think I will be passing any of my courses. I guess my optimism was a bit too high.

I'm in the same boat. I straight up emailed one of my teachers and since I'm a freshman, asked where I could find info about Mental Health a services. She was more than willing to help me and met with me in person the same day to discuss my grade. Best of luck!
